technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring's modular architecture to implement reactor-based stream processors similar to Spark and RxJava patterns.
Upgrade to Reactor 2.0 RC1 by updating dependency management and ensuring compatibility with existing modules.
Implement Redis-based aggregation for field-value counters using Redis data structures like hashes and sorted sets.
Isolate Hadoop tests into a separate project to decouple them from the DIRT project and avoid classpath issues.
Create acceptance tests for XD + YARN on EC2 using infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
Expose HTTP source module message size configuration via servers.yml to allow runtime overrides.
Leverage existing Spring-XD plugin mechanisms to minimize boilerplate for reactor processor modules.
assumptions: Developers have prior experience with Spring Framework, Reactor, RxJava, and Redis.
The existing codebase follows standard Maven or Gradle project structure.
EC2 instances for YARN testing are pre-provisioned or accessible via CI/CD pipeline.
Reference documentation is maintained in a standard format like Asciidoc or Markdown.
The previous implementation specs for field-value counters are accessible and sufficient for porting.
All required dependencies for Reactor 2.0 RC1 are available in public repositories.
The team has access to necessary cloud credentials and permissions for EC2-based testing.

activities.activity_description: Design a plugin mechanism for reactor-based stream processors that mirrors Spark and RxJava approaches, allowing minimal configuration with extensibility via module options.
Implement the core reactor processor plugin with support for specifying processor class and additional configuration via module options.
Update project dependencies to use Reactor 2.0 RC1 and resolve any compatibility issues with existing modules.
Port specifications for Redis-based aggregation over field-value counters from the previous Spring XD implementation.
Analyze ported specs and identify any functional or technical gaps compared to the original implementation.
Develop the Redis-based aggregation module for field-value counters with continuous write capabilities during data ingestion.
Update reference documentation to include details about the Redis-based aggregation feature and usage.

activities.activity_name: Isolate Hadoop Tests into Separate Project
activities.activity_description: Move Hadoop-related tests into a dedicated project to remove DIRT project dependency and fix Eclipse classpath generation issues.

activities.activity_name: Create Acceptance Tests for XD + YARN on EC2
activities.activity_description: Develop and configure acceptance tests to verify simple XD features running on YARN within an EC2 environment on every build cycle.
Create a processor module that allows users to leverage RxJava APIs for data computations.

activities.activity_name: Expose HTTP Source Message Size Configuration
activities.activity_description: Modify the HTTP source module to allow overriding the default 1MB message size limit via servers.yml configuration.
Perform integration testing across all implemented features to ensure compatibility and correctness.
